title: Your Open Door Policy Is Killing Your Team's Productivity — Here's Why
script: Your open door policy isn't making you approachable. It's making you and your team less productive. Here's why. Every time an employee can interrupt you at any moment, two things happen: you can't do your best thinking, and they learn to interrupt instead of solve problems independently. The fix isn't a closed door. It's a structure. Set two office hours per week — times when you're fully accessible. Block the rest for deep work. Tell your team this builds trust, not limits it. Closed doors aren't rejection. They're effectiveness. The best managers protect their own time so they can protect their team's time too.
